````text
# #2498: Patch: every card's words other than its rules in one editable YAML file
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Right now a card's plain text is spread over three files in two formats, and each has its own conventions:

| Text | Where it lives now |
|---|---|
| Flavour line and artist credit (R660) | `crates/cards/flavour.json`, `{ "<id>": { flavour?, artist? } }` |
| Voice lines: `play`, `attack`, `death`, `cast`, `trigger` (R655, R1088, R1448) | the `text` of each hook in the `cards` section of `apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5`, mixed in with voices and effects |
| The six hero portraits' emote lines (R644) | the `emotes` section of `card-audio.json5` |
| Chinese name and faces, `previews` (R1303) | `crates/cards/chinese.json` |

This moves all of it into **one hand-edited YAML file**, e.g. `crates/cards/card-text.yaml`, so a writer can change any card's words in one place. Each entry is keyed by catalog id and listed in catalog order, with the card's English name in a comment beside the id (as `card-audio.json5` does now). The emote lines get their own top-level section. Roughly:

```yaml
core-001: # Big D-fender
  flavour: He never learned to swing. He learned to stand very, very still.
  voice:
    play: Stand behind me. Way behind.
    attack: Defense is offense!
    death: Defense... offended.
  zh:
    name: 大D守卫
    base: "光环：你处于守备表示的单位拥有+{armor}点护甲。"
    radiant: "光环：你处于守备表示的单位拥有+{armor}点护甲。"
emotes:
  vanilla:
    greetings: Hello. I'm Mr. Vanilla. That's it.
    # …
```

**Out of scope:**
- `catalog.json`'s `name` and face `text`. They are card data: the classifier and `patches check` read them, and changing them needs fragments.
- The `flavor` animation category in `catalog.json` (docs/polish/8-flavor.md). It is an enum, not text.
- Voice definitions, effects, and which voice each hook uses. These stay in `card-audio.json5`.
- The `PORTRAITS` voice-direction strings in `crates/engine/src/wire/emotes.rs`.

**Constraints the plan must respect:**
- **CLAUDE.md rule 4.** No YAML parser goes into a pure crate's dependencies, and the workspace has none today. The suggested route:
  - The YAML is the only file anyone edits.
  - A generator (a `cargo jackioh` subcommand or a test in the style of `tests/export_config.rs`) writes whatever derived files the readers need: `flavour.json`, `chinese.json`, and the voice-line text the client merges with `card-audio.json5`.
  - Each derived file carries a "generated from card-text.yaml, do not edit" header, and CI fails when a run changes it.
  - `include_str!`, the web's `@jackioh/cards/*.json` imports and `gen-voice.mjs` then barely change.
  - If the plan prefers to have readers parse the YAML directly (a web dependency, a `build.rs` build-dependency), it must justify that against rule 4 and `crates/cards/Cargo.toml`'s comment.
- **No string may change.** This is a move only. If any voice line's text changes, `voice-manifest.json` / `voice-assets.test.ts` will demand a re-render that Linux cannot do (ADDING_CARDS §7), so prove every string is byte-identical before and after.
- **No card plays differently.** `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` should report no plays, and no pending fragment is needed (R660, R1437000).

### Acceptance

- [ ] One YAML file holds every catalog card's and token's flavour line, artist credit, voice-line texts and Chinese entry (`name`, `base`, `radiant`, `previews`), plus the six portraits' five emote lines each, in catalog order with name comments.
- [ ] No other hand-edited file in the tree holds any of those strings. `flavour.json`, `chinese.json` and the `text` fields in `card-audio.json5` are deleted or generated, and CI fails if a generated file is stale.
- [ ] A test proves every string is byte-identical to `main` before the migration. `node apps/web/scripts/gen-voice.mjs --check` and `voice-assets.test.ts` pass with no re-rendered audio.
- [ ] Every existing contract still holds, through its existing tests now reading the YAML or its outputs:
  - `crates/cards/tests/cross/flavour.rs` and `tests/cross/chinese.rs`
  - `apps/web/src/cards/flavour.test.tsx`
  - `src/audio/voice-lines.test.ts`, `voiceData.test.ts` and `gen-voice.test.ts`
  - `src/emotes/play.test.ts`
  - `src/routes/almanac.test.tsx`
  - `wording.test.ts`

  They check trimmed single lines, the 120/60-character caps, no rules words, every id a catalog card or token, every card covered, Unit play/attack/death lines (R1448), name comments matching the catalog, and `{key}` placeholders and `previews` matching the English face and script.
- [ ] Rule 4 holds: no new dependency in `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai` or `crates/luau`, and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] Docs and notes name the new file. At least:
  - `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`, rows 8, 9 and 13 and the renamed-card notes
  - the ruling notes `spec/rulings/R0660.md`, R0655, R1303 and R1448
  - `spec/08-catalog.md` and `spec/10-engine-guide.md`
  - `crates/cards/README.md`, `crates/cards/src/lib.rs`'s docs and `apps/web/README.md`
  - `card-audio.json5`'s header and `apps/web/src/cards/art/ART.md`

  Search for `flavour.json`, `chinese.json` and `card-audio.json5` to find the rest, including card scripts' comments. If a new path is read from outside its crate, add it to `scripts/ci-scope.sh`'s map.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check`, `catalog check`, `patches check` and `classify --base origin/main --claims` pass with no fragment, and the full test commands in CLAUDE.md are green.

### Blocked by, part of

Nothing.

2. **The YAML.** Save this converter as `/tmp/card-text-migration/convert.mjs`, outside the tree. Run `node /tmp/card-text-migration/convert.mjs .` from the repo root. In planning, `yaml_serde` parsed its output and serde_json's pretty print reproduced main's `flavour.json` and `chinese.json` byte for byte.
```js
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
const repo = path.resolve(process.argv[2]);
const JSON5 = createRequire(path.join(repo, "apps/web/package.json"))("json5");
const read = (file) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(repo, file), "utf8");
const catalog = JSON.parse(read("crates/cards/catalog.json"));
const flavour = JSON.parse(read("crates/cards/flavour.json"));
const chinese = JSON.parse(read("crates/cards/chinese.json"));
const audio = JSON5.parse(read("apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5"));
const scalar = (s) =>
  /^\p{L}[^\n\r\t]*$/u.test(s) && !/: |:$| #|\s$/.test(s) && !/^(true|false|null|yes|no|on|off|y|n)$/i.test(s)
    ? s
    : JSON.stringify(s);
const out = [];
for (const [id, card] of Object.entries(catalog)) {
  out.push(`${id}: # ${card.name}`);
  const f = flavour[id] ?? {};
  if (f.flavour !== undefined) out.push(`  flavour: ${scalar(f.flavour)}`);
  if (f.artist !== undefined) out.push(`  artist: ${scalar(f.artist)}`);
  const hooks = Object.entries(audio.cards[id] ?? {}).filter(([, a]) => a.voice !== undefined);
  if (hooks.length > 0) out.push("  voice:");
  for (const [hook, a] of hooks) {
    if (hook !== "trigger") out.push(`    ${hook}: ${scalar(a.text)}`);
    else out.push("    trigger:", ...a.lines.map((line) => `      - ${scalar(line)}`));
  }
  const z = chinese[id];
  if (z !== undefined) {
    out.push("  zh:", ...["name", "base", "radiant"].map((k) => `    ${k}: ${scalar(z[k])}`));
    if (z.previews !== undefined) {
      out.push("    previews:", ...Object.entries(z.previews).map(([en, zh]) => `      ${scalar(en)}: ${scalar(zh)}`));
    }
  }
}
out.push("emotes:");
for (const [portrait, e] of Object.entries(audio.emotes)) {
  out.push(`  ${portrait}:`, ...["greetings", "wellPlayed", "oops", "thanks", "threaten"].map((k) => `    ${k}: ${scalar(e[k])}`));
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(repo, "crates/cards/card-text.yaml"), `${out.join("\n")}\n`);
```
   Then put a `#` comment block and a blank line at the top of the file. It states:

3. **`crates/tools/tests/export_card_text.rs`.** Use the shape of `crates/server/tests/export_cosmetics.rs`.

     - `YAML = concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../cards/card-text.yaml")`
     - `FLAVOUR` → `"/../cards/flavour.json"`
     - `CHINESE` → `"/../cards/chinese.json"`
     - `VOICE_TEXT` → `"/../../apps/web/src/audio/voice-text.json"`

     Each literal must directly follow `env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),`, because acceptance.rs scans for that.
   - **`HEADER`:** "Generated from crates/cards/card-text.yaml by crates/tools/tests/export_card_text.rs. Do not edit: change the YAML, then run cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text." No R-ids in it.
   - **Input types**, each with `Deserialize` and `deny_unknown_fields`:
     - `CardText { flavour, artist: Option<String>, voice: Option<Voice>, zh: Option<Chinese> }`
     - `Voice { play, attack, death, cast: Option<String>, trigger: Option<Vec<String>> }`
     - `Chinese { name, base, radiant: String, previews: Option<IndexMap<String, String>> }`
     - `Emote { greetings, well_played, oops, thanks, threaten: String }` with `rename_all = "camelCase"`

     The last three also derive `Serialize`, with each `Option` field skipped when `None`.
   - **Output types** (`Serialize` only):
     - `Flavour<'a> { flavour, artist: Option<&'a String> }`, each skipped when `None`
     - `Sidecar<'a, T> { #[serde(rename = "//")] header: &'a str, #[serde(flatten)] entries: IndexMap<&'a str, T> }`
     - `VoiceText<'a> { "//" header, cards: IndexMap<&'a str, &'a Voice>, emotes: &'a IndexMap<String, Emote> }`

     Never serialize a `serde_json::Value` map: there is no `preserve_order`, so its keys would come out sorted.
   - **`fn parse(text: &str) -> Result<(IndexMap<String, CardText>, IndexMap<String, Emote>), String>`:**
     - Read with `yaml_serde::from_str::<yaml_serde::Mapping>`, which refuses duplicate keys.
     - For each key, `emotes` goes through `from_value::<IndexMap<String, Emote>>` and every other key through `from_value::<CardText>`.
     - Errors read `card-text.yaml: <id>: <error>`. A non-string key is an error.
   - **`fn render() -> [(&'static str, String); 3]`:** each output is `serde_json::to_string_pretty(..) + "\n"`.
     - flavour: every card with a flavour or an artist.
     - chinese: every card with `zh`.
     - voice text: every card with `voice`, then the emotes.

The ids equal `jackioh_cards::CATALOG`'s keys in order, and each name equals `CATALOG[id].name`.

import fs from "node:fs";

import { createRequire } from "node:module";

const chinese = JSON.parse(read("crates/cards/chinese.json"));

const scalar = (s) =>

    ? s

const out = [];

  const f = flavour[id] ?? {};

  if (f.artist !== undefined) out.push(`  artist: ${scalar(f.artist)}`);
  const hooks = Object.entries(audio.cards[id] ?? {}).filter(([, a]) => a.voice !== undefined);
  if (hooks.length > 0) out.push("  voice:");
  for (const [hook, a] of hooks) {
    if (hook !== "trigger") out.push(`    ${hook}: ${scalar(a.text)}`);
    else out.push("    trigger:", ...a.lines.map((line) => `      - ${scalar(line)}`));
  }
  const z = chinese[id];
  if (z !== undefined) {

    if (z.previews !== undefined) {
      out.push("    previews:", ...Object.entries(z.previews).map(([en, zh]) => `      ${scalar(en)}: ${scalar(zh)}`));
    }
  }
}
out.push("emotes:");
for (const [portrait, e] of Object.entries(audio.emotes)) {
  out.push(`  ${portrait}:`, ...["greetings", "wellPlayed", "oops", "thanks", "threaten"].map((k) => `    ${k}: ${scalar(e[k])}`));
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(repo, "crates/cards/card-text.yaml"), `${out.join("\n")}\n`);

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
const repo = path.resolve(process.argv[2]);
const JSON5 = createRequire(path.join(repo, "apps/web/package.json"))("json5");
const read = (file) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(repo, file), "utf8");
const catalog = JSON.parse(read("crates/cards/catalog.json"));
const flavour = JSON.parse(read("crates/cards/flavour.json"));
const chinese = JSON.parse(read("crates/cards/chinese.json"));
const audio = JSON5.parse(read("apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5"));
const scalar = (s) =>
  /^\p{L}[^\n\r\t]*$/u.test(s) && !/: |:$| #|\s$/.test(s) && !/^(true|false|null|yes|no|on|off|y|n)$/i.test(s)
    ? s
    : JSON.stringify(s);
const out = [];
for (const [id, card] of Object.entries(catalog)) {
  out.push(`${id}: # ${card.name}`);
  const f = flavour[id] ?? {};
  if (f.flavour !== undefined) out.push(`  flavour: ${scalar(f.flavour)}`);
  if (f.artist !== undefined) out.push(`  artist: ${scalar(f.artist)}`);
  const hooks = Object.entries(audio.cards[id] ?? {}).filter(([, a]) => a.voice !== undefined);
  if (hooks.length > 0) out.push("  voice:");
  for (const [hook, a] of hooks) {
    if (hook !== "trigger") out.push(`    ${hook}: ${scalar(a.text)}`);
    else out.push("    trigger:", ...a.lines.map((line) => `      - ${scalar(line)}`));
  }
  const z = chinese[id];
  if (z !== undefined) {
    out.push("  zh:", ...["name", "base", "radiant"].map((k) => `    ${k}: ${scalar(z[k])}`));
    if (z.previews !== undefined) {
      out.push("    previews:", ...Object.entries(z.previews).map(([en, zh]) => `      ${scalar(en)}: ${scalar(zh)}`));
    }
  }
}
out.push("emotes:");
for (const [portrait, e] of Object.entries(audio.emotes)) {
  out.push(`  ${portrait}:`, ...["greetings", "wellPlayed", "oops", "thanks", "threaten"].map((k) => `    ${k}: ${scalar(e[k])}`));
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(repo, "crates/cards/card-text.yaml"), `${out.join("\n")}\n`);
```
